instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT center-align the main App container.
For the Hero section, use a glassmorphism overlay on the background image to ensure the search bar and offers banner are clearly visible.
Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., item added to cart).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
No completely transparent header. Use backdrop-blur with off-white tint.
Implement the shopping cart as a slide-out drawer or a dedicated page with clear summary.
Checkout page should cleanly separate Address form, Payment Method (UPI QR/COD), and Order Summary.
Admin panel should use a high-density layout, removing extra padding for efficient data scanning (products list, orders, stock alerts).
Implement order tracking with a visual vertical or horizontal stepper timeline (Pending -> Confirmed -> Packed -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism. Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Provide micro-animations for interactions. Ensure rich spacing (2x-3x typical). Maintain accessibility standards.
